processes.title: BDOIR End-to-End
processes.summary: The umbrella flow that chains new business, cashiering, collections, remittance, disbursement, the general ledger, renewal and claims. Each link is captured in detail in its own process below; these screens show the control points that tie the chain together.

steps.step: Executive dashboard: KPIs across the whole chain (in force, in placement, unapplied payments, pending approvals, disbursements in flight, past-TAT requests)
steps.action: Sign in; the dashboard opens.
steps.result: KPI tiles for policies in force, in placement, premium and commission YTD, outstanding premium, unapplied payments, pending approvals, disbursements in flight, open claims, renewals due, past-TAT requests and screening hits.
steps.rule: Each tile reads the same tables the processes write; there is no separate reporting copy.

steps.step: Single maker-checker queue for bookings, endorsements, journals, disbursements, CTE, claim settlements, EB awards and product changes
steps.action: Open Approvals & Audit and the All tab.
steps.result: Every approval request across modules with maker, checker, status and note.
steps.rule: One registry, eight request types, segregation of duties on all of them.

steps.step: Production, collection and claims reports with CSV export
steps.action: Open Reports & Analytics.
steps.result: Production by product and insurer, collections ageing, claims by status, with CSV export.
steps.rule: Reports are entitlement-scoped (RPT module).

steps.step: Client onboarding with sanctions screening, PEP flag and risk tiering feeding every process
steps.action: Open Sanction Screening & Risk.
steps.result: Client register with screening status, PEP, risk score and tier; hits offer Clear (false positive) or Decline.
steps.rule: Compliance decides hits; declined clients cannot transact.

steps.step: Twelve personas with module entitlements and approver rights (segregation of duties)
steps.action: Open User Access Maintenance.
steps.result: Users with role, department, status and module entitlements; create user with a temporary password.
steps.rule: Roles define modules and approver rights; menus and APIs enforce them.

steps.step: Legacy data migration batches with load, reconciliation and disposition
steps.action: Open Data Migration.
steps.result: Batches with source count, loaded count, variance and disposition.
steps.rule: A batch with variance requires a disposition before it is accepted.

processes.title: New Business
processes.summary: Client creation and screening, quotation, proposal, placement to the insurer, e-policy and booking under maker-checker.

steps.step: MAO creates the client in Broker; KYC details captured
steps.screen: Sanction Screening & Risk › New client form
steps.action: Open Sanction Screening & Risk, fill in the new client form and press Create & screen.
steps.result: The client is created with a client number and screened against the sanctions and PEP lists in the same call.
steps.rule: Every client is screened before any quotation can be issued for it; a hit blocks new business until Compliance clears it.

steps.step: Client is sanction-screened automatically (clear / hit) and risk-tiered
steps.action: Read the toast and the new row in the client register.
steps.result: Toast confirms the client number, screening result and risk tier; the row shows the CDD level and screening status.
steps.rule: Risk tier drives the customer due-diligence level (simplified / standard / enhanced).
toasts: CLT-2026-00066 created · screening clear · tier low

steps.step: Quotation prepared with the rating engine (premium, VAT, DST, LGT, commission)
steps.screen: New Business › Quotations & proposals › New quotation form
steps.action: Pick the client, the packaged product and the insurer, enter the sum insured and press Create quotation.
inputs: Insurer: first accredited insurer on the panel
Hold cover (days): blank unless the insurer must hold cover before placement
steps.result: The rating engine computes premium, VAT, DST, LGT and FST, and the broker commission from the product rates.
steps.rule: Non-packaged products cannot be quoted here; they require an approved TSU proposal first (see Product Maintenance / TSU).
toasts: CLT-2026-00066 created · screening clear · tier low

steps.step: Quotation created (status: quoted); hold cover can be requested from the insurer
steps.action: Check the new quotation row and its computed amounts.
steps.result: Quotation number QT-YYYY-NNNNN assigned; status quoted; the row offers Send proposal.
steps.rule: Acceptance limits and the survey threshold on the product are checked at quotation time.
toasts: CLT-2026-00066 created · screening clear · tier low

steps.step: Proposal sent to the client by email (status: proposal sent)
steps.screen: New Business › Quotations & proposals › Send proposal
steps.action: Press Send proposal on the quotation row.
steps.result: The proposal is emailed to the client (see Outbox) and the status moves to proposal sent.
steps.rule: Order is enforced: a quotation must be quoted before a proposal can be sent.
toasts: CLT-2026-00066 created · screening clear · tier low

steps.step: Client acceptance recorded (Y); a decline with reason is the N branch
steps.screen: New Business › Quotations & proposals › Client accepted
steps.action: Press Client accepted once the signed proposal or proof of payment is received.
steps.result: Acceptance recorded with a timestamp; Request placement becomes available.
steps.rule: Declined is the N branch: a decline reason is captured and the quotation is closed.

steps.step: Placement requested: placement slip goes to the insurer via SFTP or email
steps.action: Press Request placement; the policy shell opens in a drawer.
steps.result: Policy POL-2026-00068 created in status placement requested; the placement slip is sent by SFTP when the insurer is enrolled, otherwise by email.
steps.rule: Placement channel is decided by the insurer record (SFTP-enrolled or not).

steps.step: Placement board tracks slips awaiting the insurer, returns and e-policies
steps.action: Open the Placement tab.
steps.result: Every policy awaiting the insurer is listed with slip sent time, return reason and the next action.
steps.rule: A placement returned by the insurer carries a reason routed to marketing and can be resubmitted.

steps.step: Insurer placed the risk; e-policy received (COG via SFTP or PO email)
steps.screen: New Business › Placement › Placed / e-policy received
steps.action: Press Placed / e-policy received and enter the insurer policy reference in the prompt.
steps.result: Status placed; e-policy channel recorded; Book & invoice becomes available.
steps.rule: E-policy exceptions are routed to the contact centre with an exception note.

steps.step: Booking and invoicing raised for checker approval (maker-checker)
steps.action: Press Book & invoice.
steps.result: A policy_issue approval request is raised; the policy waits in pending approval.
steps.rule: Maker-checker: the officer who books cannot approve; segregation of duties is enforced by the approval registry.

steps.step: Underwriting Head (checker) reviews the booking request
steps.action: Open Approvals & Audit; the Pending tab lists requests raised by makers.
steps.result: The request shows type, summary, maker, maker note and time raised.
steps.rule: Only users with approver rights on the module can decide; a maker can never approve their own request.

steps.step: Booking approved: invoice, journal and e-policy dispatch are posted automatically
steps.action: Press Approve and enter a checker note.
steps.result: Policy in force, invoice generated, booking journal posted and the e-policy dispatched on the recorded channel.
steps.rule: Every decision is written to the audit trail with before/after state.

steps.step: Policy register: the policy is in force with its invoice and e-policy channel
steps.action: Open the Policies tab.
steps.result: Policy POL-2026-00068 shows in force with inception, expiry, premium, insurer reference and e-policy channel.
steps.rule: Only in-force, renewed or expired policies can carry claims.

steps.step: Policy detail: placement history, e-policy status and the exception route to the contact centre
steps.action: Click the policy row to open its detail drawer.
steps.result: Drawer shows period, taxes, commission, placement/booking/e-policy timestamps, invoices and claims.
steps.rule: E-policy exception sends the case to the contact centre with the exception note.

processes.title: Operations
processes.summary: Cashiering channels, post-dated cheque hold, unapplied premium, direct payments with commission receivables, adjustments and production reconciliation.

steps.step: Cashiering: open invoices (premium receivables) awaiting payment
steps.action: Open Operations; the Invoices & cashiering tab lists premium receivables.
steps.result: Each invoice shows billed, paid, balance and status; open ones offer Receive.
steps.rule: Invoices are generated automatically when the checker approves booking.

steps.step: Receive payment: channel (bills payment, OTC cash/cheque, batch files, autopay) and reference
steps.action: Press Receive on the invoice, choose the channel and enter the cheque details.
inputs: Amount: defaults to the invoice balance
steps.result: The form is ready to post; cheque channels will be held for clearing.
steps.rule: Channels mirror the flow: bills payment, OTC cash/cheque, CLPC/PMS/trade batch files, direct credit, autopay.

steps.step: Cheque payment recorded and held for the 4-day clearing period
steps.action: Press Record payment.
steps.result: Toast shows the hold-until date; the payment is created in status held and is not yet applied to the invoice.
steps.rule: Post-dated / OTC cheques are held four days before they can mature and apply.

steps.step: PDC register: held cheques, matured, bounced (exclusion list) and unapplied premium
steps.action: Open the Payments / PDC / UPP tab.
steps.result: The held cheque appears with Matured and Bounced actions; unapplied premium rows offer Apply to invoice.
steps.rule: A bounced cheque is tagged with a reason and feeds the exclusion list.

steps.step: Held cheque shows Matured / Bounced actions once the 4-day hold lapses
steps.screen: Operations › Payments / PDC / UPP › Held cheque
steps.action: Attempting Matured before the hold date is refused by the API.
steps.result: Conflict: "Cheque is on hold until <date> (4-day clearing)"; after the date, Matured applies the payment and issues the OR.
steps.rule: PDC monitoring: maturity cannot be forced before the clearing period.

steps.step: Cash / bills payment applied in full: official receipt issued and receivable cleared
steps.action: Receive the same invoice again through a cash / bills-payment channel and press Record payment.
steps.result: Official receipt OR-YYYY-NNNNN issued; invoice status paid; cash and premium journals posted.
steps.rule: An applied payment posts Dr Cash / Cr Premium receivable and books the commission income.

steps.step: Payment with zero PR / payment greater than PR is recorded without an invoice
steps.screen: Operations › Invoices & cashiering › Payment without invoice
steps.action: Press Payment without invoice and enter the amount received.
steps.result: The payment can be posted even though no premium receivable matches it.
steps.rule: Zero-PR and excess payments never sit against an invoice; they go to unapplied premium.

steps.step: The amount sits in Unapplied Premium (GL 2400) until applied to an invoice
steps.action: Open Payments / PDC / UPP and find the unapplied row.
steps.result: Status unapplied with the unapplied amount; Apply to invoice prompts for the invoice id.
steps.rule: Unapplied premium is a liability (GL 2400) until matched; refunds of UPP go through the RRF.

steps.step: Direct payment to insurer identified for a booked policy
steps.action: Enter the policy number the client paid directly to the insurer and press Identify direct payment.
steps.result: The invoice is tagged direct-paid and a commission receivable is booked against the insurer.
steps.rule: Direct-paid policies are excluded from the remittance extract; the broker collects only its commission.

steps.step: Commission receivable (GL 1250) billed to the insurer; follow-up until collected
steps.action: Press Bill insurer on the receivable row.
steps.result: Status billed; the billing letter is queued to the insurer. Rejected / Re-bill handle disputes.
steps.rule: Commission receivable lifecycle: identified → billed → approved → collected.
toasts: Direct payment identified; commission receivable booked

steps.step: Commission collected: commission official receipt issued
steps.action: Press Insurer approved, then Collect (commission OR).
steps.result: Status collected; a commission OR is issued and Dr Cash / Cr Commission receivable is posted.
steps.rule: Only approved receivables can be collected.

steps.step: Adjustment / cancellation validated by the Adjustment Team and routed to the checker-poster
steps.action: Fill in the endorsement: policy, type, premium delta, refund and description, then press Submit for posting.
inputs: Type: adjustment (cancellation is the other type)
Description: Premium adjustment: sum insured reduced per client request
steps.result: An endorsement number is assigned and an endorsement approval is raised.
steps.rule: Endorsements post only after the checker-poster approves; a cancellation sets the policy to cancelled.

steps.step: Endorsement pending checker approval; a refund creates a Refund Request Form (RRF) on approval
steps.action: Check the endorsement register.
steps.result: The endorsement waits in pending; on approval the premium delta is journaled and an RRF is raised for the refund.
steps.rule: Refund Request Forms originate from endorsements or unapplied premium, never from free-form entry.
toasts: Endorsement sent to checker for posting

steps.step: Production reconciliation: insurer production file matched against booked policies
steps.action: Choose the insurer, the booking period and paste the production register rows, then press Match & classify.
inputs: Insurer: first insurer on the panel
steps.result: A reconciliation run is created with one classified row per line.
steps.rule: Rows are classified matched, with discrepancies (premium or reference differs) or unbooked (policy unknown).
toasts: Endorsement sent to checker for posting

steps.step: Rows classified as matched, with discrepancies, or unbooked; each gets a disposition
steps.action: Read the result: counts per class and the detail rows.
steps.result: Toast summarises matched / discrepancies / unbooked; the run detail lists each row with a Disposition action.
steps.rule: Unbooked rows must be dispositioned (book, insurer error, cancelled) before the run closes.
toasts: Endorsement sent to checker for posting

steps.step: Checker-poster reviews the endorsement
steps.action: Open Approvals & Audit; the Pending tab lists requests raised by makers.
steps.result: The request shows type, summary, maker, maker note and time raised.
steps.rule: The checker-poster must be a different user from the maker (segregation of duties).

steps.step: Endorsement posted: premium and commission reversed, RRF raised for the refund
steps.action: Press Approve and enter a checker note.
steps.result: Endorsement status posted; adjustment journal booked; RRF created in status submitted for the refund amount.
steps.rule: Every decision is written to the audit trail with before/after state.

processes.title: Marketing Collections
processes.summary: Premium receivable list by stage, marketing diary, credit-term extension under approval and statement of account.

steps.step: PR list: newly booked accounts to collect within 10–15 days; ageing and collection stage per invoice
steps.action: Open Collections; the outstanding register lists every unpaid invoice.
steps.result: Each row shows days since booking, days overdue, ageing bucket and the collection stage (newly booked, within credit term, committed, overdue, escalate).
steps.rule: Newly booked accounts are collected within 10–15 days; commitments must fall within the 60-day credit term.

steps.step: Statement of account sent to the client
steps.action: Press SOA on the invoice row.
steps.result: The statement lists all open invoices of the client with balances and ageing, ready to send.
steps.rule: SOA is the collection instrument for account-level follow-up.

steps.step: Marketing diary: when / where / how / what of each collection effort, commitment date and arrangement
steps.action: Press Log effort and record the contact.
inputs: Mode / arrangement / remarks: as agreed with the client
steps.result: The effort is added to the diary and the invoice stage is recomputed.
steps.rule: Every effort captures when, where, how and what, so the diary is auditable.

steps.step: Commitment beyond the 60-day credit term: MAO informed, tagged as committed
steps.action: Read the toast after logging.
steps.result: Toast warns the commitment is beyond the credit term and that the MAO was emailed; stage becomes committed.
steps.rule: A commitment past the credit term requires a credit-term extension (CTE) approved by the unit head.
toasts: Effort logged · commitment is beyond the credit term, marketing AO informed

steps.step: Credit-term extension (CTE) requested for Unit Head approval
steps.action: Press CTE and answer the prompts.
steps.result: A cte approval request is raised; the invoice shows the pending extension.
steps.rule: CTE extends the due date only after approval; the request is maker-checker.
toasts: Effort logged · commitment is beyond the credit term, marketing AO informed
CTE requested; awaiting unit head approval

steps.step: Effort diary per invoice with category tagging
steps.action: Press Diary on the row.
steps.result: All efforts for the invoice, with mode, category, commitment, arrangement, contact and who logged it.
steps.rule: Tagging status / category drives the escalation stage.
toasts: Effort logged · commitment is beyond the credit term, marketing AO informed
CTE requested; awaiting unit head approval

steps.step: Unit / Finance Head reviews the CTE request
steps.action: Open Approvals & Audit; the Pending tab lists requests raised by makers.
steps.result: The request shows type, summary, maker, maker note and time raised.
steps.rule: Only users with approver rights on the module can decide; a maker can never approve their own request.

steps.step: CTE approved: due date extended and account stays within term
steps.action: Press Approve and enter a checker note.
steps.result: Invoice due date extended by the approved days; stage returns to within credit term / committed.
steps.rule: Every decision is written to the audit trail with before/after state.

processes.title: FRBS Accounting
processes.summary: Chart of accounts, system-generated journals, manual entries under review, trial balance, period and year-end closing.

steps.step: System-generated journals (booking, receipts, commissions) and manual entry form routed to the TL for posting
steps.action: Open the Journals tab: the register lists automatic journals; the form drafts a manual entry.
steps.result: Route for posting raises a journal approval; system journals are already posted.
steps.rule: Manual journals post only after the TL / FRBS approver decides; debits must equal credits.

steps.step: Trial balance and financial reports generated from the ledger
steps.action: Open Trial balance; optionally filter by period (YYYY-MM).
steps.result: Debit and credit totals per account with the balanced indicator.
steps.rule: The ledger is double-entry; the trial balance must always balance.

steps.step: EOD / EOM / EOY: period close and reopen, fiscal-year close to retained earnings
steps.action: Open Periods & year-end: close a month, reopen with a reason, or close the fiscal year.
inputs: Reason to reopen: required when reopening
steps.result: Closed periods reject new postings; the year-end close posts nominal balances to retained earnings.
steps.rule: Only the Finance Head may reopen a closed period.

processes.title: Disbursement
processes.summary: Disbursement chain DPO → DTL → DSH → DUH with segregation of duties, payment posting and confirmation email; weekly remittance to insurers.

steps.step: Weekly remittance extract of applied payments per insurer, sanitised and submitted to Disbursement
steps.action: Open Remittances: the extract groups applied payments due to each insurer.
steps.result: Per insurer: number of policies and net amount; Submit creates the remittance schedule and its disbursement request.
steps.rule: Direct-paid and already-remitted policies are excluded from the extract.

steps.step: Disbursement request (DPO) with payee, amount, mode and bank details
steps.action: Fill in the disbursement request and press Request.
steps.result: A voucher number is assigned in status pending review.
steps.rule: The requester (DPO) cannot review or approve their own voucher.

steps.step: Request awaits a reviewer other than the maker (segregation of duties)
steps.action: Check the voucher row.
steps.result: Status pending review; Review OK / Reject are hidden from the maker.
steps.rule: Segregation of duties: maker, reviewer, approver and payer are distinct roles or users.

steps.step: Team lead review (DTL) OK; routed to the Finance Head for approval
steps.action: As the team lead, press Review OK on the voucher.
steps.result: Status pending approval; a disbursement approval request is raised for the Finance Head.
steps.rule: Review confirms supporting documents before approval.

steps.step: Finance Head (DSH / DUH) reviews the voucher
steps.action: Open Approvals & Audit; the Pending tab lists requests raised by makers.
steps.result: The request shows type, summary, maker, maker note and time raised.
steps.rule: Only users with approver rights on the module can decide; a maker can never approve their own request.

steps.step: Approved; ready for payment
steps.action: Press Approve and enter a checker note.
steps.result: Voucher status approved; the payer can now release payment.
steps.rule: Every decision is written to the audit trail with before/after state.

steps.step: Payment posted with cheque reference; status tagged paid and confirmation email sent
steps.action: Press Pay and enter the cheque / transaction reference.
steps.result: Status paid with timestamp; payment journal posted; confirmation email queued to the payee.
steps.rule: Payment posts Cr Cash / Dr the payable account of the voucher type.

processes.title: Refund Request
processes.summary: Refund Request Form raised from a cancellation, TL review, Unit Head sign-off and hand-off to the disbursement chain.

steps.step: RRF register: refund raised by the endorsement with amount, mode and reason
steps.action: Open Refund requests.
steps.result: RRF for POL-2026-00068 in status submitted with amount ₱1,500.00, mode credit to account and the endorsement as reason.
steps.rule: The RRF carries the MAO who raised it; TL review must be by someone else.

steps.step: Marketing TL reviews the RRF
steps.screen: Accounting & Disbursement › Refund requests › TL review OK
steps.action: Press TL review OK.
steps.result: Status reviewed; UH approve becomes available to an approver.
steps.rule: Review and approval are separate steps by separate people.

steps.step: Unit Head sign-off: a disbursement request is created for the refund
steps.screen: Accounting & Disbursement › Refund requests › UH approve
steps.action: As Unit Head, press UH approve.
steps.result: Status approved and a refund disbursement voucher is created automatically.
steps.rule: Refunds are paid only through the disbursement chain.

steps.step: Refund enters the disbursement chain (review → approve → pay)
steps.action: Open Disbursements and find the refund voucher.
steps.result: Type refund, payee the client, status pending review.
steps.rule: Same DPO → DTL → DSH → DUH chain as any other disbursement.

processes.title: ACSL (Insurer SOA reconciliation)
processes.summary: Insurer statement of account reconciled against the ledger; abnormal balances raise adjustment entries reviewed by the TL and posted by the FRBS approver.

steps.step: Insurer SOA lines captured against the ledger
steps.action: Choose the insurer, paste the statement lines and press Reconcile.
inputs: Insurer: first insurer on the panel
steps.result: A reconciliation run compares each statement line with the ledger balance for the policy.
steps.rule: Statement total, ledger total and variance are stored per run.

steps.step: Variances flagged (abnormal balances, unknown items) for manual subsidiary-ledger adjustment
steps.screen: Accounting & Disbursement › ACSL / SOA recon › Result
steps.action: Read the run: per policy statement vs ledger, variance and whether the policy is known.
steps.result: Lines with variance or unknown policies are flagged; Adjust drafts the correcting entries.
steps.rule: Adjustment entries are routed to the FRBS approver; nothing posts directly from the recon.

processes.title: Claims
processes.summary: Notice of loss, PLA, document checklist, FLA to the insurer, evaluation and offer, contest loop, settlement approval and closure.

steps.step: Notice of loss registered against the policy (Claims Acceptance Control checks premium status)
steps.action: Fill in the notice of loss and press Register.
steps.result: Claims Acceptance Control checks the policy is in force and the premium is paid before accepting.
steps.rule: CAC: an unpaid premium or a cancelled policy blocks registration with an explicit reason.

steps.step: Preliminary Loss Advice (PLA) sent; claim opened with reserve
steps.action: Read the toast and the new claim row.
steps.result: Claim CLM-YYYY-NNNNN registered, reserve set to the estimate and the PLA emailed to the client.
steps.rule: The document checklist is generated by line of business (motor vs non-motor CRF).
toasts: Claim CLM-2026-00014 registered · Preliminary Loss Advice sent

steps.step: Document checklist by line (motor / non-motor); FLA blocked until complete
steps.action: Click the claim row to open the detail drawer.
steps.result: Checklist rows (claim form, police report, licence, OR/CR, photos, estimate) all pending; the FLA button is not offered yet.
steps.rule: Formal Loss Advice cannot be sent until every required document is received.
toasts: Claim CLM-2026-00014 registered · Preliminary Loss Advice sent

steps.step: All requirements received: documents complete
steps.action: Press Received on each checklist row as documents arrive.
steps.result: Pill shows documents complete; Send Formal Loss Advice appears.
steps.rule: Received dates are kept per document for TAT reporting.

steps.step: Formal Loss Advice sent to the insurer; adjuster inspection flagged
steps.action: Press Send Formal Loss Advice and confirm whether an adjuster inspection is needed.
steps.result: Status fla sent; adjuster pill shown; FLA emailed to the insurer.
steps.rule: Adjuster requirement is recorded for follow-up with the insurer.

steps.step: Insurer evaluation and offer received
steps.action: Press Insurer evaluating, then Offer received and enter the offer amount.
steps.result: Status offer received with the offer stored against the reserve.
steps.rule: Offer below estimate can be contested; acceptance closes the evaluation loop.

steps.step: Insured contests the offer; re-evaluation loop with the insurer
steps.action: Press Contest offer and state the position.
steps.result: Status offer contested; the insurer re-evaluates and a new offer can be recorded.
steps.rule: The contest loop can repeat until the insured accepts or the claim is declined.

steps.step: Settlement by LOA to casa/dealer or cash requested for approval
steps.screen: Claims › Claim detail › Request settlement approval
steps.action: After Insured accepts, press Request settlement approval and choose LOA or cash.
inputs: Settle by LOA to casa/dealer? Yes (Cancel = cash)
steps.result: Status settlement requested; a claim_settlement approval is raised.
steps.rule: Settlement mode (LOA vs cash) is recorded; approval is maker-checker.

steps.step: Approver reviews the settlement
steps.action: Open Approvals & Audit; the Pending tab lists requests raised by makers.
steps.result: The request shows type, summary, maker, maker note and time raised.
steps.rule: Only users with approver rights on the module can decide; a maker can never approve their own request.

steps.step: Settlement approved
steps.action: Press Approve and enter a checker note.
steps.result: Claim status settlement approved; the claims officer can mark it settled / paid.
steps.rule: Every decision is written to the audit trail with before/after state.

steps.step: Claim tagged settled / paid, then closed; declination is the alternative exit
steps.action: Reopen the claim and press Mark settled / paid.
steps.result: Status settled with paid amount; Close finishes the claim.
steps.rule: Decline (with reason) is available at any open stage as the alternative exit.

processes.title: Case Management (To-Be)
processes.pdf: CASE MANAGEMENT TO BE PROCESS FLOW_07152026.pdf
processes.summary: General vs account-related inquiries, positive identification, point-of-contact handling or referral to the fulfilment unit, TAT monitoring and return to CCC.

steps.step: Contact logged: general inquiry (no client) vs account-related concern
steps.action: Log the contact: leave Client blank for a general inquiry, choose the concern and describe it.
inputs: Description: What are your office hours?
Handled at point of contact: yes
steps.result: The case is created and, being general, closed immediately.
steps.rule: General inquiries close at point of contact; account-related concerns need PID.

steps.step: General inquiry handled and closed at point of contact
steps.action: Read the toast and the case row.
steps.result: Request number assigned; case type general; status closed.
steps.rule: No TAT applies to a case closed at point of contact.
toasts: SR-2026-00023 logged and closed at point of contact

steps.step: Account-related concern: positive identification (PID) and routing to the owning unit with a TAT
steps.action: Select the client, choose the concern, describe it and quote the PID answer given by the caller.
inputs: Description: Client disputes the amount on the latest invoice
steps.result: PID is verified against the registered TIN or email; the case is routed to Operations with a TAT due time.
steps.rule: A failed PID blocks the case with reason PID_FAILED.
toasts: SR-2026-00023 logged and closed at point of contact

steps.step: Case referred to the fulfilment unit; TAT due time computed and past-TAT flagged
steps.action: Check the new case row.
steps.result: Owning unit OPS, status open, TAT due timestamp; past-TAT cases are flagged on the dashboard.
steps.rule: TAT monitoring: tat_due_at = logged time + category TAT hours.
toasts: SR-2026-00023 logged and closed at point of contact

steps.step: Case returned to the Customer Contact Centre for re-logging with a reason
steps.screen: Customer Servicing › Cases › Return to CCC
steps.action: Press in progress, then Return to CCC and give the reason.
inputs: Return reason: Mis-routed to billing; policy concern
steps.result: Status returned with the reason stored; the fulfilment unit no longer owns it.
steps.rule: Return is allowed from open or in progress only.

steps.step: Case re-logged and back in the open queue
steps.action: Press Re-log.
steps.result: Status open again; the CCC re-routes it to the correct unit.
steps.rule: Lifecycle: open → in progress → resolved → closed, with returned → open as the loop.

processes.title: Customer Servicing Facility
processes.summary: Search by invoice, policy or client name; view policies, invoices and receipts; update contact details.

steps.step: Servicing facility: search by invoice no., policy no. or client name
steps.action: Open Servicing facility, type an invoice number, policy number or client name and press Search.
steps.result: Matching clients with their policies, invoices and receipts.
steps.rule: Search is entitlement-scoped to the servicing modules.

steps.step: Client contact details updated from the facility
steps.screen: Customer Servicing › Servicing facility › Update contact
steps.action: Press Update contact and enter the new email and phone.
steps.result: Contact saved; the change is audited with before/after values.
steps.rule: Contact updates are audited; PID applies before changes are accepted over the phone.

processes.title: Renewal (RMEL)
processes.summary: Renewal master expiry list 140 days out, sanitation and disposition, initial and final RA letters, client acceptance and renewal placement.

steps.step: RMEL: policies expiring within 140 days, pending sanitation
steps.action: Open Renewal; the pipeline is the renewal master expiry list.
steps.result: Policy POL-2026-00071 (expiring in 30 days) listed as pending sanitation with its days-to-expiry.
steps.rule: RMEL window: 140 days before expiry.

steps.step: Sanitation: disposition for renewal / remarket / not for renewal (NRNS letter)
steps.action: Press For renewal (or Remarket, or Not for renewal with a reason).
steps.result: Disposition stored; RA letter actions appear according to the timing rules.
steps.rule: Not for renewal sends the NRNS letter automatically.

steps.step: Initial renewal advice letter sent 70 days before expiry
steps.action: Press Initial RA (−70d).
steps.result: Initial renewal advice emailed to the client and logged as a notice.
steps.rule: Initial RA is offered only once the policy is inside the 70-day window.

steps.step: Final renewal advice letter sent 45 days before expiry
steps.action: Press Final RA (−45d).
steps.result: Final renewal advice emailed; both notices show on the row.
steps.rule: Final RA requires the initial RA to have been sent first.

steps.step: Client accepted: renewal policy enters placement and the e-policy cycle
steps.action: Press Client accepted, then Renew → placement and enter the renewal sum insured.
steps.result: A renewal policy is created in placement requested and linked to the expiring one.
steps.rule: Renewal placement follows the same placement → booking → e-policy lifecycle as new business.

processes.title: Reinsurance
processes.summary: Facultative request with 24-hour acknowledgement and 3-day slip TAT, underwriting information loop, reinsurer security rating, signed slips, closing and debit note; treaties and cessions.

steps.step: Facultative placement request from marketing with the risk details
steps.action: Fill in the facultative request and press Request placement.
inputs: Risk description: Petrochemical plant, sum insured PHP 2B
steps.result: Request FAC-YYYY-NNNNN created in status requested.
steps.rule: The 24-hour acknowledgement TAT starts at request time.

steps.step: Request logged; acknowledgement due within 24 hours (TAT flag)
steps.action: Check the request row.
steps.result: Status requested with the acknowledgement due time; late rows are flagged.
steps.rule: TAT: acknowledge within 24 hours, slip within 3 working days.

steps.step: Acknowledged; slip due within 3 working days
steps.action: Press Acknowledge (or Info received / Return incomplete when underwriting information is missing).
steps.result: Status acknowledged; slip due date computed.
steps.rule: Incomplete underwriting information loops back to marketing with what is missing.

steps.step: Slip: reinsurers approached with security rating, share and signed-slip evidence
steps.action: Press Prepare slip, add each reinsurer with rating, share and premium, tick Signed slip, then Save slip.
steps.result: Slip saved; placed share shown against the share sought.
steps.rule: Security rating gate: reinsurers below the minimum rating are rejected; shares must total the sought share before closing.

steps.step: Closing: placement closed and debit note issued to the cedant
steps.action: Press Close & debit note.
steps.result: Status placed; closing recorded and the debit note emailed to the cedant.
steps.rule: Closing requires signed slips for every line.
toasts: Placed · closing and debit note DN-2026-00008 sent to cedant

steps.step: Treaty register and cessions with capacity monitoring
steps.action: Open Treaties & cessions: register treaties and cede policies.
inputs: Treaty: code, name, reinsurer, type (quota share / surplus / XOL / facultative), cession rate, capacity, period
steps.result: Cessions reduce remaining treaty capacity.
steps.rule: A cession beyond capacity is refused.
toasts: Placed · closing and debit note DN-2026-00008 sent to cedant

processes.title: Submitted Policies
processes.summary: Masterlist validation, matching and consolidation, adequacy review with IAAF findings, and hand-off to sanitation 150 days from expiry.

steps.step: Masterlist upload from the bank / insurer for validation and matching
steps.action: Choose the insurer for matching, paste or upload the masterlist CSV and press Run pipeline.
inputs: Insurer (for matching): first insurer on the panel
File: CSV of policy no, client, premium, insurer, expiry
steps.result: A batch is created and every row validated and matched against booked policies.
steps.rule: Rows are classified matched / unmatched / duplicate before consolidation.

steps.step: Rows validated, matched and consolidated; each reviewed for adequacy
steps.screen: Submitted Policies › Masterlist batches › Run pipeline
steps.action: Open the batch: each row offers Adequate or Findings → IAAF.
steps.result: Batch totals and per-row classification with adequacy pending.
steps.rule: Adequacy compares sum insured with the loan / collateral value.

steps.step: Findings recorded and an Insurance Adequacy Assessment Form (IAAF) issued
steps.action: Press Findings → IAAF on a row and describe the finding.
inputs: Findings: Sum insured below loan value
steps.result: IAAF number issued and emailed; row marked with findings.
steps.rule: Adequate rows need no IAAF.

steps.step: Policies 150 days from expiry sent to the sanitation handler for renewal / conversion opportunity
steps.action: Open Expiring (150 days).
steps.result: Submitted policies expiring within 150 days, ready for the sanitation handler.
steps.rule: Conversion opportunities proceed through New Business; NRNS cases are noted.

processes.title: Employee Benefits
processes.summary: Renewal advice, BOR, TOR with master list and utilisation released to insurers, comparative analysis, award with ISACOM for non-accredited providers, handoff.

steps.step: Prospect scheme created from the renewal advice
steps.action: Fill in the scheme and press Create scheme.
steps.result: Scheme EB-YYYY-NNNNN created in status prospect.
steps.rule: A scheme needs a BOR before insurers can be approached.

steps.step: Broker of Record received, Terms of Reference prepared, member census uploaded
steps.action: Open the scheme, press BOR received, TOR prepared, then paste the census and press Upload census.
inputs: Census rows: member no, name, birth date, dependents
steps.result: Scheme documents flagged; members listed with covered lives count.
steps.rule: Master list and utilisation are part of the TOR pack.

steps.step: TOR, master list and utilisation released to insurers (franchise)
steps.screen: Employee Benefits › Release TOR to insurers
steps.action: Select the insurers to approach and press Release TOR to insurers.
inputs: Insurers: first two on the panel (non-accredited ones are marked)
steps.result: Proposal requests created per insurer in status requested.
steps.rule: Non-accredited insurers can quote but an award to them needs ISACOM approval.
toasts: TOR, master list and utilisation released to insurers

steps.step: Comparative analysis of proposals: premium, benefits and capabilities
steps.action: Press Record proposal for each insurer and enter premium, benefits and capabilities score.
inputs: Insurer 1: ₱11,500 / life; Room and board 4,000; MBL 150,000; dental; capabilities 85
Insurer 2: ₱12,800 / life; Room and board 3,500; MBL 120,000; capabilities 70
steps.result: Proposals sorted by premium with benefits and capability score side by side.
steps.rule: Comparative analysis covers premium, benefits and capabilities (stability, providers, technology).
toasts: TOR, master list and utilisation released to insurers

steps.step: Client confirmation and award; ISACOM approval when the provider is not accredited; handoff to processing and collections
steps.action: Press Award on the chosen proposal after client confirmation.
steps.result: Scheme placed and the handoff email sent, or ISACOM approval requested when the insurer is not accredited.
steps.rule: eb_award approval type gates non-accredited providers.
toasts: Awarded · handoff to processing and collections

processes.title: Product Maintenance (TSU)
processes.summary: Technical Services Unit request for non-packaged risks: completeness and duplicate check, quotation slip, TL approval, RI referral, insurer responses, comparative table and proposal slip; package maintenance with release advisory.

steps.step: PRF / TSU request for a non-packaged risk with completeness and duplicate check
steps.action: Fill in the TSU request and press Submit to TSU.
inputs: Risk details: Warehouse complex, sprinklered, Class A construction
steps.result: Request TSU-YYYY-NNNNN created; duplicates for the same client and risk are rejected.
steps.rule: Completeness and duplicate checks run on submission.
toasts: CLT-2026-00070 created · screening clear · tier low

steps.step: TSU acknowledges the request (or returns it as incomplete)
steps.action: Press Acknowledge on the request row (Return incomplete is the alternative).
steps.result: TSU-2026-00013 acknowledged; Prepare quotation slip appears.
steps.rule: An incomplete request goes back to marketing and re-enters on Resubmitted.
toasts: CLT-2026-00070 created · screening clear · tier low

steps.step: Quotation slip prepared and approved by the TL
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › TL approve QS
steps.action: Press Prepare quotation slip and describe the terms, then TL approve QS.
inputs: Quotation slip: Fire and allied perils, PHP 30M, deductible 1%
steps.result: Status qs approved; the slip can be referred to RI or sent to insurers.
steps.rule: TL approve QS is available to approvers only (green button).

steps.step: RI referral cleared; quotation slip sent to insurers
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › Send QS to insurers
steps.action: Press Refer to RI, then RI cleared → send to insurers.
steps.result: Status sent to insurers; insurer responses can be recorded in the detail card.
steps.rule: Risks above treaty capacity are referred to RI before quoting.

steps.step: Insurer responses recorded (accepted with evidence / declined / conditional); comparative table ready
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › Comparative table
steps.action: Press Record response per insurer and enter premium, evidence and conditions; then Comparative table ready.
steps.result: Status comparative ready; responses listed for comparison.
steps.rule: An acceptance without evidence (signed / stamped slip or explicit email) is not accepted.

steps.step: Proposal slip approved with the selected insurer; released to marketing and the client
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › Approve proposal slip
steps.action: Press Approve proposal slip, choose the insurer and describe the proposal.
inputs: Proposal slip: Malayan selected: best terms, no exceptions
steps.result: Status proposal approved; New Business can now quote the non-packaged product against this proposal.
steps.rule: A non-packaged quotation must reference an approved TSU proposal.

steps.step: Packaged product catalogue with rates, taxes and limits
steps.action: Open Packages: the catalogue of packaged products.
steps.result: Each product shows base rate, commission, VAT/DST/LGT/FST, minimum premium, maximum sum insured and survey threshold.
steps.rule: Changes to a product go through a maintenance request, never a direct edit.

steps.step: Package maintenance request raised for validation and approval
steps.action: Press Change request on the product and answer the prompts.
steps.result: A product_change approval is raised.
steps.rule: Product changes are maker-checker and publish a release advisory on approval.

steps.step: Approver validates the product change
steps.action: Open Approvals & Audit; the Pending tab lists requests raised by makers.
steps.result: The request shows type, summary, maker, maker note and time raised.
steps.rule: Only users with approver rights on the module can decide; a maker can never approve their own request.

steps.step: Change applied and a release advisory published
steps.action: Press Approve and enter a checker note.
steps.result: Product updated; release advisory recorded and emailed to the distribution list.
steps.rule: Every decision is written to the audit trail with before/after state.

steps.step: Insurer panel with accreditation and SFTP enrolment for placement channels
steps.action: Open Insurers to maintain the panel.
inputs: Code, insurer name, accredited, SFTP enrolled
steps.result: Accreditation drives ISACOM on EB awards; SFTP enrolment drives the placement channel.
steps.rule: Only accredited insurers appear in the New Business insurer picker by default.
